MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Ellen Chaitin, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: B. Fields, CSR #7235.

Sally Noma, Esq. appeared for plaintiff California Capital Insurance Company

Order waiving witness appearance at default prove-up hearing was in file.

Default has been entered against the Defendant.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff(s), and against the Defaulted DefendantRamon Morales Rodriquez for Judgment as follows:

Damages/Principal - $75,497.00
Prejudgment Interest - $4,844.00
Costs - $429.00
Total judgment in the amount of $80,770.00

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
